text:
New York City's residents are known as "Knickerbockers." The name comes from the descendants of the early Dutch settlers (popularized by Washington Irving's Diedrich Knickerbocker) and was later applied to New Yorkers generally, giving the NBA's New York Knicks their name. The note about Thames watermen in seventeenth-century England doesn't match what I know of the term's origin, so I'm not adopting it.
